name: MLP with Positional Encoding
definition: A neural rendering module that predicts RGB color from input features, view directions, and positions using a Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) with positional encoding applied to both position and view direction.
summary: MLP with Positional Encoding predicts RGB color by applying sinusoidal encodings to raw 3D positions and view directions before concatenating them with input features for neural rendering.
